Expansion02Main_Belle/Belle_SEC_E02_Beas.en: Did you help the Beast make a perfect day for me, {PlayerName}?

Expansion02Main_Belle/Belle_SEC_E02_Beas.en: Nope. It was all the Beast.
I helped, but it was all the Beast's idea.
Expansion02Main_Belle/Belle_SEC_E02_Beas.cz: Pomáhal jsem, ale byl to celý nápad Bestie.

Expansion02Main_Belle/Belle_SEC_E02_Beas.en: I did MOST of the work...
Well, it was a wonderful gesture.
The Bind looks so <Lore>cozy</Lore> now after all you've done!
